verdict.rationale: Atlassian's features page claims 'Rich APIs'. Community users independently confirm hands-on use of the REST API: one wrote API wrapper scripts to submit bug reports, and others run JQL queries via REST. This shows the product can be driven programmatically through a public API. The OpenAPI probe found nothing, but only at guessed paths, so it does not contradict this. missing for 10: in-depth first-party API reference documentation in the evidence, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths 404), and detail on API coverage and auth.
